discover.metaDesc: Learn what AIESEC in Bardo's platform is, why Tunisia is worth it, and what your exchange journey looks like from application to departure.
discover.heroSubtitle: Everything you need to know about AIESEC in Bardo, and what a cultural exchange in Tunisia actually looks like.
discover.whatBardoP1: Bardo is AIESEC in Bardo's immersive experience platform — a digital companion designed to help incoming exchange participants discover Tunisia before and during their exchange. It covers everything from food and places to visit, to cost of living, transport, and cultural guidance.
discover.whatBardoP2: The name "Bardo" references the Bardo National Museum in Tunis — one of the most important archaeological museums in the world, housed in a 13th-century palace. Like the museum, this platform is a gateway to understanding Tunisia's depth, history, and living culture.
discover.aiesecP1: AIESEC is a global youth-led organisation present in more than 120 countries. AIESEC in Bardo has been active since 1984 and connects young people to volunteer projects, professional internships, and cultural exchange opportunities.
discover.aiesecP2: In Tunisia, AIESEC collaborates with NGOs, startups, schools, and local organisations to create meaningful experiences. Each project is linked to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and contributes to real impact on communities.
